Promotion Rules
Important Notes
## 1. Participation Details
Users are deemed to have read and agreed to the Bitget Simple Earn Product Agreement.
Promotion rewards apply to main accounts only and are valid only during the promotion period. Institutional users are not currently eligible.
To view the Simple Earn APR boost promotion in the app, update the Bitget app to version V2.91.0 or later.
## 2. Net deposit calculation
Net deposit amount = deposit amount − withdrawal amount. Internal transfers are not counted.
The USDT activity tracks net deposits in USDT, USDC and USDGO, all converted to USDT for calculation. The BTC, ETH and XAUT activities track net deposits of the respective coins only.
## 3. Eligibility updates and effective time
The system checks each user's net deposits and subscriptions daily and automatically updates promotion eligibility between 12:00 AM and 8:00 AM (UTC+8) the following day. Once eligibility is updated, the corresponding Simple Earn product starts earning the boost; users who do not meet the conditions receive the base APR only.
Both net deposit and interest accrual follow T+1 logic. For example, a subscription or net deposit completed between 11:00 PM and 11:59:59 PM (UTC+8) on day D is counted as of 12:00 AM on day D+1, and promotion eligibility is updated on day D+2.
## 4. Boost calculation and limits
Promotion rewards apply only to principal within each promotion's boost cap. Any amount above the cap does not earn the promotion boost.
Promotion rewards are calculated daily on the user's hourly average holdings from the previous day.
Redeeming principal during the promotion period may void your eligibility or affect the bonus APR you are currently earning.
Total promotion rewards are capped and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Individual rewards are also capped; once your individual cap is reached, no further promotion rewards will be granted.
## 5. Rule changes and violations
Users must complete identity verification and meet the product and promotion eligibility requirements that apply in their country or region.
Data, limits, APRs and reward estimates displayed on the promotion page are for reference only. The final basis is Bitget's backend settlement records and the relevant promotion announcements. If the promotion cannot proceed normally due to system issues, market conditions, liquidity, regulatory requirements, force majeure or other reasonable causes, Bitget reserves the right to adjust the promotion rules, limits, APR, eligibility and promotion period.
All participants must strictly comply with Bitget's terms and conditions. If fraud, the use of multiple accounts to claim rewards, or participation through electronic, bot, duplicate or automated means is detected, Bitget reserves the right to disqualify the participant and revoke their rewards, and promotion rewards on the relevant accounts will be voided.
This promotion is open only to users who meet Bitget's eligibility requirements and whose participation is not restricted by applicable laws, regulatory requirements, regional restrictions, or Bitget's internal policies. Users in restricted regions, users with restricted accounts, and any other users who do not meet Bitget's eligibility requirements may not register for or participate in this promotion, or receive or claim any promotion rewards. Users are responsible for confirming that their participation does not violate the laws and regulations that apply in their location. Bitget may adjust eligibility for this promotion based on legal, regulatory, or risk control requirements. Eligibility, eligible trading volume, and rewards are determined in accordance with these promotion rules and Bitget's final backend settlement records. To the extent permitted by applicable law, Bitget may adjust, suspend, or cancel this promotion due to legal or regulatory requirements, risk control, market changes, system maintenance, force majeure, or other reasonable and necessary causes.
By participating in this promotion, you are deemed to have read, understood, and agreed to the Bitget User Agreement, Privacy Policy, applicable product terms, risk disclosures, and these promotion rules. Bitget reserves the right to revise the promotion terms or cancel the promotion at any time without prior notice, and retains the final right of interpretation of these terms. If you have any questions, please contact our customer service team.

Headline: Binance Earn Launches BTC Yield APR Boost Promotion with Up to an Additional 2% APR for VIP Users
Start: 2026-11-17T03:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-16T23:59:00Z
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Fellow Binancians,
Binance Earn is running a limited-time BTC Yield (BTCY) promotion, offering additional rewards for both new net subscriptions and existing holdings.
Promotion Period: 2026-11-17 03:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-16 23:59 (UTC)
During the Promotion Period, eligible VIP 1 to VIP 9 users may receive an additional APR Boost of up to 2% on new net subscriptions and 0.5% on existing holdings. Eligible Regular users may receive up to 1% on new net subscriptions and 0.25% on existing holdings.
## Reward Structure
User Type | Daily Average Newly Subscribed Holdings During the Promotion Period | Additional APR Boost
VIP 1 - VIP 9 users | 0.01 ≤ Daily average holdings < 1 | 0.5%
1 ≤ Daily average holdings < 5 | 1%
5 ≤ Daily average holdings ≤ 20 | 2%
Regular users | 0.01 ≤ Daily average holdings < 1 | 0.25%
1 ≤ Daily average holdings < 5 | 0.5%
5 ≤ Daily average holdings ≤ 20 | 1%
Existing holdings are determined by a snapshot taken on 2026-11-17 00:00 (UTC).
User Type | Daily Average Existing Holdings During the Promotion Period | Additional APR Boost
VIP 1 - VIP 9 users | 0.01 ≤ Daily average holdings ≤ 20 | 0.5%
Regular users | 0.01 ≤ Daily average holdings ≤ 20 | 0.25%
## How to Participate
New net subscriptions: Users who make new net BTCY subscriptions on or after 2026-11-17 00:00 (UTC) will be eligible for additional APR Boost rewards for new holdings during the Promotion Period.
Existing holdings: Users who hold BTCY at the snapshot taken on 2026-11-17 00:00 (UTC) will be automatically enrolled. The BTCY balance recorded will be treated as the user’s existing holdings, and may receive the APR Boost.
Each user’s holdings will be split daily into existing and new holdings, as follows:
Daily Existing Holdings = The lower of (i) the user’s BTCY holdings on that day and (ii) the user’s snapshot balance.
Daily New Holdings = The user’s BTCY holdings on that day minus the user’s snapshot balance.
If the value is negative, it will be zero.
Note: Redeeming existing BTCY holdings and subsequently re-subscribing will not be considered new net subscriptions and will not qualify for additional rewards during the Promotion Period.
## How to Get Started
## App
Step 1: Tap [More] on the App homepage.
Step 2: Go to [Earn] > [BTC Yield].
Step 3: Tap [Subscribe] and enter the amount of BTC to commit.
Step 4: Read and agree to the terms and tap [Confirm].
Step 1: Navigate to the [Earn] section, select [Advanced Earn] and click [BTC Yield].
Step 2: Click [Subscribe] and enter the amount of BTC to commit.
Step 3: Read and agree to the terms and click [Confirm].
## Notes:
The total reward pool is equivalent to 70,000 USD in BTCY. Rewards are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis until the reward pool is depleted. BTCY exchange rate is calculated based on the conversion rate announced the day the campaign ends.
The additional APR applies to eligible BTCY holdings from 0.01 BTCY to 20 BTCY. Users may receive APR Boost on up to 20 BTCY of new holdings and up to 20 BTCY of existing holdings.
For the portion exceeding 20 BTCY in either category, the additional APR does not apply. Only the native yield generated under the standard BTC Yield product rules will be earned.
Account Aggregation: Holdings of the master account and its sub-accounts will be aggregated for calculation and are subject to a single reward cap; sub-accounts are not eligible for a separate allocation.
The APR boost for each holdings tier applies to the entire holdings, not just the portion within that tier. For example, a VIP user with Daily Average New Holdings of 15 BTCY receives a 2% APR Boost on all 15 BTCY. The tier does not affect the APR Boost for existing holdings.
## VIP Reward Eligibility
To qualify for the additional 2% APR Boost Reward for new subscriptions or 0.5% for existing subscriptions, VIP users must continuously maintain their Binance VIP status at any tier, throughout all 30 Reward Calculation Days during the Promotion Period. If the user becomes a VIP after the Promotion has started or loses VIP status during the Promotion Period, they will not be eligible.
Binance will record each user’s VIP status daily at 00:00 (UTC). If a user does not meet the VIP eligibility requirement on any Reward Calculation Day, all rewards for the Promotion will be calculated using the Regular user APR Boost rate.
VIP status and VIP tier will be determined based on Binance’s system records.
## Reward Calculation:
Binance will record each user’s confirmed BTCY holdings daily at 00:00 (UTC) during the Promotion Period.
## Daily eligible holdings will be calculated as follows:
If a user’s BTCY holdings are below 0.01 BTCY on a given day, the eligible holdings for that day will be zero.
If a user’s BTCY holdings are equal to or greater than 0.01 BTCY, the actual holdings will be counted, subject to a maximum of 20 BTCY per day.
The average eligible holdings during the Promotion Period will be calculated as follows:
Daily Average Eligible Holdings = Sum of Daily Eligible Holdings for All 30 Reward Calculation Days / 30
VIP User APR Boost Reward for new net subscriptions: Reward = (Daily Average Eligible Holdings × APR × 30) / 365
Regular User APR Boost Reward for new net subscriptions: Reward = (Daily Average Eligible Holdings × APR × 30) / 365
VIP User APR Boost Reward for existing holdings: Reward = (Daily Average Eligible Holdings × 0.50% × 30) / 365
Regular User APR Boost Reward for existing holdings: Reward = (Daily Average Eligible Holdings × 0.25% × 30) / 365.
## Case Example:
Please review examples for the total rewards for an eligible VIP user and a Regular user who has daily average newly subscribed holdings of 20 BTCY and holds 20 BTCY referring to snapshot taken on 2026-11-17 00:00 (UTC), during the entire Promotion Period.
 | VIP Users | Regular Users
Newly Subscribed Holdings (BTCY) | 20 | 20
Additional APR Boost | 2% | 1%
Additional Rewards (BTCY) | 0.0328767 | 0.0164384
Existing Holdings (BTCY) | 20 | 20
Additional APR Boost | 0.5% | 0.25%
Additional Rewards (BTCY) | 0.0082192 | 0.0041096
Total Rewards (BTCY) | 0.0410959 | 0.0205480
Final reward amounts will be subject to Binance’s system calculations.
## Reward Distribution
Rewards will be calculated based on daily holdings snapshots.
If the reward pool is fully depleted before the end of the Promotion Period, the accrual of APR Boost Rewards will end early.
Rewards will be automatically distributed to eligible users’ Spot Accounts on or before 2026-12-30 23:59 (UTC) after the Promotion Period ends.
Pending subscriptions and holdings for which redemption has been completed will not be included in the daily holdings snapshots.
## Guides and Related Materials
BTC Yield Product Page
Frequently Asked Questions on BTC Yield
BTC Yield Product Terms
## Terms and Conditions
Only users who complete identity verification and meet the aforementioned criteria during the Promotion Period can qualify for rewards in the Promotion. The products or features referred to above may not be available in your region. Users are responsible for informing themselves about and observing any restrictions and/or requirements imposed with respect to the access to and use of Binance services in each country from which the services are accessed.
Holdings of the master account and its sub-accounts shall be aggregated and subject to a single reward cap. Sub-accounts shall not be entitled to a separate allocation.
The BTC Yield Product Terms apply.
